Media Outlets Focus on Home Remedies for Skin

Several Hindi news outlets have published articles offering home remedies for achieving glowing skin. The coverage highlights the use of ingredients like turmeric and specific 'red drinks' as natural alternatives to expensive beauty treatments. These articles suggest that such remedies can quickly restore radiance and combat dullness.
